info.title: Delivery Plus Public API
info.description: Public Gateway contract for the Delivery Plus food delivery platform. This specification exposes the canonical public paths behind the API Gateway and intentionally excludes internal-only service routes.

post.summary: Register a new account

201.description: Registered. Signed in (AuthResponse), or, while email verification is required, VerificationRequiredResponse with no tokens

post.summary: Login and receive an access token and a refresh token

403.description: AccountSuspended: the account is suspended (show the suspended screen). EmailNotVerified: email verification is required and this email is not verified yet (show the code screen). Both only after the password checked out

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new pair (single use; reuse ends the session)

200.description: A new access token and a new refresh token; the one sent no longer works

401.description: InvalidRefreshToken: unknown, expired, revoked or already used (reusing one ends its session). Sign in again

403.description: AccountSuspended: the account is suspended (show the suspended screen)

429.description: Too many refreshes for this session

post.summary: Sign out this device (always 204)

204.description: Signed out (also returned for an unknown token)

post.summary: Sign out on every device

204.description: Every session of the user ended. Access tokens already issued expire on their own

patch.summary: Suspend or reactivate an account (staff with users.manage; suspending ends its sessions)

403.description: Not staff, no users.manage permission, a staff account, or your own account

post.summary: Verify an email address with the 6-digit code from the verification email

401.description: Invalid or expired verification code (wrong, used, expired or invalidated): ask for a new one

post.summary: Email a new verification code (one a minute per address)

200.description: The same answer whether or not the address has an account

429.description: Too soon: one code a minute per address, 5 an hour; and 20 an hour per client IP

503.description: EmailUnavailable: email is not set up yet, or the provider failed (show "try again later")

post.summary: Change the current user password; ends every other session

204.description: Password changed. Every other session is revoked; the current one stays signed in.

400.description: CurrentPasswordIncorrect: the current password is wrong (or the account is locked); counts as a failed sign-in attempt. Or a validation error: the new password is under 8 characters or equals the current one

401.description: Not signed in (missing, expired or revoked access token)

429.description: Too many attempts: 5 a minute per user

post.summary: Request a password reset code by SMS

202.description: The same answer whether or not the phone has an account

400.description: Validation error: not an Egyptian mobile number

429.description: Too many requests: 5 a minute per client, and hourly limits per client IP (20) and per phone (5)

503.description: SmsUnavailable: SMS is not set up yet. A provider failure still answers 202 so nothing reveals the account (show "try again later")

post.summary: Reset the password using the SMS code; ends every session

204.description: Password reset. Every session of the account is revoked and the lockout is cleared.

400.description: Validation error: bad phone, code is not 6 digits, or password under 8 characters

401.description: Invalid or expired code (wrong, used, expired or out of attempts): ask for a new one

429.description: Too many attempts: 10 a minute per client

CartChangedError.description: #42: 409 when the cart no longer matches the menu. The cart has already been updated.

DriverNotVerifiedError.description: #206: 403 when a driver who is not VERIFIED tries to go online. The app shows "waiting for review" (PENDING) or "not approved" (REJECTED).

error.description: RestaurantBusy: try again in a few minutes. RestaurantClosed: CLOSED or SUSPENDED.

distanceKm.description: Straight-line distance rounded to two decimals.

maxRadiusKm.description: Effective restaurant radius rounded to two decimals.

appId.description: #34: the app signing in, recorded on the session.

AccountStatusRequest.description: #202: staff with users.manage. Staff accounts and your own account are refused (403).

reason.description: Why it is suspended; for staff, not shown to the user.

sessionsRevoked.description: Refresh sessions ended by this change.

refreshToken.description: The latest refresh token. Each one works once.

VerificationRequiredResponse.description: #34: register while email verification is required. No tokens until the email is verified and the user logs in.

appId.description: #34: the app signing up, recorded on the session.

CreateOrderRequest.description: Optional. Without deliveryAddress the customer's profile address is used; the address is copied onto the order. 400 if neither has one.

token.description: #203: the 6-digit code from the email. It works once, for 10 minutes; the 5th wrong code invalidates it.

phone.description: Egyptian mobile number associated with the account.

AuthResponse.description: #34: a short-lived access token (Bearer) and a single-use refresh token.

accessToken.description: JWT for Authorization: Bearer. 15 minutes by default.

refreshToken.description: Opaque. Send it to POST /api/auth/refresh; it works once.

refreshTokenExpiresAt.description: 30 days after the last refresh by default (sliding).

legalName.description: #208: the registered name; the only legal detail required to submit. Never public.

contactPhone.description: #208: an Egyptian mobile, stored as E.164; required to submit. Never public.

legalName.description: #208: the registered name; the only legal detail required to submit. Never public.

contactPhone.description: #208: an Egyptian mobile, stored as E.164; required to submit. Never public.

deliveryRadiusKm.description: Effective radius, including the configured default.

distanceKm.description: Present only when lat and lng are supplied to the list endpoint.

approvalStatus.description: #208: always APPROVED on public routes; customers never see a restaurant that is not approved.

OwnerRestaurant.description: #208: the owner's view of their restaurant: the public card plus the application.

approvalStatus.description: DRAFT: fill in and submit. SUBMITTED: waiting for review. APPROVED: can open. REJECTED: fix what the note says and submit again.

approvalNote.description: The reviewer's latest note, e.g. what to fix.

StaffRestaurantApplication.description: #208: the application as staff see it, with the owner and every decision, newest first.

note.description: Shown to the owner. Required to reject.

submittedAt.description: The application's submittedAt as the reviewer saw it.

RestaurantApplicationIncompleteError.description: #208: 422 when submit (or an approval) finds the application incomplete.

DriverDocumentType.description: #207: the documents a driver application needs; all five are required.

nationalIdNumber.description: The 14-digit Egyptian national ID. Only its last 4 digits and a keyed hash are stored; it is never returned.

drivingLicenceExpiresOn.description: Cairo date; not in the past, at most 15 years ahead.

vehicleLicenceExpiresOn.description: Cairo date; not in the past, at most 15 years ahead.

objectKey.description: The objectKey the upload URL returned.

DriverApplication.description: #207: a driver application. Never contains a document URL or object key.

status.description: DRAFT: the driver can edit and submit. SUBMITTED: in the review queue. VERIFIED: approved. REJECTED: the driver can correct the application and submit it again.

submittedAt.description: The latest submission. A reviewer sends it back with the decision.

verificationNote.description: The reviewer's note, e.g. why the application was rejected.

lastReview.description: The latest decision, kept after a resubmission.

documents.description: The current version of each uploaded document.

expiringLicences.description: Licences valid today that expire within 14 days (Cairo), soonest first. Once one has expired, a VERIFIED driver goes back to DRAFT for re-review and offline.

StaffDriverApplication.description: #207: the application as staff see it, with every decision, newest first.

applicationSubmittedAt.description: The submission decided; null for a decision made with PATCH /drivers/:id/verification on a driver who never applied.

documents.description: The document versions that were current when the decision was made.

note.description: Shown to the driver. Required to reject.

submittedAt.description: The application's submittedAt as the reviewer saw it; if the driver resubmitted since, the review is refused.

ApplicationIncompleteError.description: #207: 422 when submit is called before every field and document is in place, or a reviewer approves an application that is no longer valid.

url.description: A presigned GET. A bearer credential: never log or store it.

uploadUrl.description: POST multipart form data to this object-storage URL.

objectKey.description: Temporary key to submit to the corresponding confirmation endpoint.

method.description: HTTP method for the upload request.

fields.description: Include every field in the multipart form before adding the image file.
